messages:
Maria Gomez: created RC from minimal-change branch to fix the caching header regression. tagging for quick sign-off, aiming for a 20m quiet window and staged promo. @Priya can you take prod-sre?
Priya Kumar: on it. will run smoke + traces, KV warm after promo. what's the pin?
Maria Gomez: pin is `v1.4.3-rc-minimal-20260323`. artifact hash sha256: abcdef1234.. (short). plan: canary 5% -> 50% -> 100% over 15m with rollback on error budget >3% or 3xx surge.
Sam Lee: sheriffs ack? I can monitor logs and abort if we see high latency. who owns rollback exec?
Alex Chen: I'll be on rollback if needed. rollback steps in runbook: `./scripts/rollback-promote.sh v1.4.2` and rollback db flag `feature.cache-fallback=true`.
DeployBot: deploy scheduled by Maria Gomez at 2026-03-23T15:40Z
DeployBot: canary stage started -> target 5% traffic. logs: deploy-id=deploy-3300001234, artifacts OK, kv-warm queued.
Priya Kumar: smoke results: basic generation endpoints ok, latency within SLO for 1k samples. starting trace sampling and synthetic traffic.
Sam Lee: seeing small 1.2% error spike on embed service but return-to-normal in 3m, keeping an eye.
Maria Gomez: updating release notes snippet: "fix(cache): correct header causing stale responses for short TTLs". will push to docs and release-draft.
Chris Morales: release notes + changelog updated. ops ETA for quiet window: 15:40–16:10Z. can we tighten to 20m to reduce blast?
Maria Gomez: agree tighten to 20m. adjust canary steps: 5% -> 50% -> 100% over 15m.
DeployBot: canary bumped to 50% -> monitoring hooks enabled.
Priya Kumar: traces look good. no regression on top-100 prompts. increasing perf sample size.
Sam Lee: getting one 5xx in auth-service at 15:52Z, looks unrelated to RC (downstream). continuing watch.
Alex Chen: prepped quick rollback checklist in channel pinned. ready to execute on :thumbsup:.
Chris Morales: approved for promo if no new signal in next 5m. @Sam @Priya ack?
Priya Kumar: ack.
Sam Lee: ack.
Maria Gomez: promoting to 100% now. tagging rollback owner Alex.
DeployBot: traffic shifted to 100%. deploy-id=deploy-3300001234, status=complete.
Priya Kumar: post-promo smoke pass ok. latency stable. telemetry shows decreased cache misses for the hot path.
Sam Lee: logs clean, no surge. marking sheriff handoff in 30m.
Alex Chen: leaving rollback watch open for 1h. if anything pops, I'll run rollback script.
Maria Gomez: thanks team. will cut final release notes and close the RC thread once docs publish. :tada:
